correctness.rationale: Complete analytic proof: Fourier diagonalization and absence of lag aliasing for N>=12 give exact equations (1+chi^s) r_s=0. r_5 nonzero restricts chi to order 2 or 10. In the order-ten case r1=r3=r4=0 forces three equilateral unit quotients; r3 requires equal moduli sqrt(3) and 1, impossible. For order 2 the two even correlation equations yield exactly (a,b,ax,epsilon i bx,-ax^2,bx^2), without missing branches. Trace fixes bound 12. Phase alphabet closure proves q divisible by four iff and 2q^3 count. Actual standalone exact Gaussian-integer checker enumerates all 4096 quadriphase six-tap windows and excludes tenth-order cancellation; separate float checker performs exhaustive normalized small alphabet tests and full Gram sums. Finite checks are corroboration, not proofs of universal quantifiers.

originality.rationale: The known 128-pair quaternary Golay census is expressly prior art. Craigen–Holzmann–Kharaghani 2002 §4.3, Parker–Paterson–Tellambura 2003, and Bright et al. 2018 cover that finite slice, not the full complex-phase two-modulation frame theorem. Magsino 2016 supplies a general tightness criterion, not the resulting continuous six-tap classification. Full-text comparison with the published three-tap full-translation Gabor study and a three-translation half-modulation study confirms neither subsumes six unimodular taps with arbitrary two-channel frequency gap. The new assertion includes a nontrivial exclusion of all order-ten gaps, exact parametrization as two three-tori, and a phase-alphabet iff/count for every integer q. Searches were bounded; hidden equivalents remain a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed older continuous-phase classification of all length-three unimodular Golay pairs may exist; its combination with a general Gabor criterion could overlap substantially.
The q=4 count 128 is definitively prior art, not an independent original component.
The primary papers and database were compared for stated claims, but not every reference or appendix of the wider polyphase sequence literature has been exhaustively checked.
No external independent mathematical audit has been conducted.

value.rationale: Natural time-frequency design question at the first nontrivial length-three interlaced Golay complementarity, beyond shorter two-modulation three-tap work. For every even cyclic length >=12, the theorem fully specifies which channel separation can yield a tight constant-envelope six-sample window, excludes the natural order-ten possibility by a structural unit-triangle obstruction, and gives the complete torus geometry and phase-quantization counts. This can guide two-channel finite tight-frame design without an unmotivated finite slice or an unsupported downstream application. The previously known q=4 pair count is excluded from claimed novelty.
